$comment: FND-09 deliverable 13 — PRD §24.1's monthly founder-funded budget, transcribed VERBATIM.
Transcription rule: the `label` and `planningBudget` cells are the PRD's own table cells,
character for character, EN DASH (U+2013) included. test/budget/prd-24-1-budget.test.ts asserts
each row occurs in docs/PRD.md as `| label | planningBudget |`, so a hyphen typed for an en dash
fails here rather than silently redefining the budget downstream.
Big integers are JSON STRINGS parsed with BigInt(...): JSON.parse would route them through a
double and PRD §34.1 forbids floating-point money.
Ceiling derivation (recorded so the Reviewer need not re-derive it): the founder monthly ceiling
is the UPPER BOUND of the §24.1 Total row (A$42–50), corroborated verbatim by §42.6's
'The monthly A$50 ceiling is an admission-control requirement, not a spreadsheet hope.'
The §42.6 reserve-order phrases are transcribed here too, because FOUNDER_RESERVE_ORDER encodes
them and nothing else in this leaf carries §42.6 text.
heading: ### 24.1 Monthly founder-funded budget
closingRule: Cloudflare Paid Workers is not a default dependency. Actual provider billing MUST be monitored; the system MUST stop before exceeding the founder-funded ceiling.

derived.founderMonthlyCeilingDerivation: Upper bound of the §24.1 Total row (A$42–50) = A$50; §42.6 names the same figure: 'The monthly A$50 ceiling'.
derived.hostedModelHardBudgetDerivation: The §24.1 'Hosted model hard budget' row, 'approximately A$12', at 1 AUD = 1 000 000 micro-AUD.
derived.totalDerivation: The §24.1 Total row 'A$42–50', low and high bound.
derived.warningThresholdDerivation: OPS-003's 90% warning: ceil(50000000 * 9000 / 10000) = 45000000 micro-AUD, computed in basis points so no float is involved.
